intro: Three things worth knowing this week before you send your next application.

articles.headline: AI job descriptions now name the tooling
articles.body: Postings that once asked for machine learning experience now name the exact stack. Listing the tools you have actually shipped with, in the words the posting uses, is doing more work than a skills section ever did.

articles.headline: Your first job on the page is the last one they read
articles.body: A recruiter reads top down and stops early. The most recent role carries most of the decision, so the strongest evidence belongs there rather than saved for a later bullet.

articles.headline: One application, read properly, beats ten sent fast
articles.body: Volume feels productive and rarely is. Reading the posting closely and answering it directly changes the outcome far more than sending the same CV to another ten companies.

cta.heading: See how a recruiter would score it
cta.body: Run your CV against the job you actually want, before you apply.
cta.label: Check
